extracted.intended_audience: trademark examiners, intellectual property professionals, and anyone classifying figurative elements in marks (users of the Vienna Classification)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference listing (Vienna Classification, 7th Edition) of categories, divisions and principal sections used to classify figurative elements in marks. Each entry defines a class of motifs (e.g., buildings, foodstuffs, textiles) with explanatory notes and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7. CONSTRUCTIONS, STRUCTURES FOR ADVERTISEMENTS, GATES OR BARRIERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading covering constructions, structures for advertisements, gates or barriers and related categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections under this division include 7.1 (Dwellings, buildings, advertisement hoardings or pillars, cages or kennels for animals), 7.3 (Parts of dwellings or of buildings, interiors), 7.5 (Monuments, stadiums, fountains), 7.11 (Structural works) and 7.15 (Building materials, walls, gates or barriers, scaffolding). See the principal-section entries for detailed examples and notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7.1 DWELLINGS, BUILDINGS, ADVERTISEMENT HOARDINGS OR PILLARS, CAGES OR KENNELS FOR ANIMALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers castles, fortresses, palaces, churches, mosques, pagodas, towers/masts/derricks (including transmitting masts), houses, skyscrapers, windmills or water mills, industrial establishments, filling stations, lighthouses, kiosks, advertisement hoardings or pillars, huts, tents, igloos, animals' cages or kennels, stylized dwellings and other dwellings or buildings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes explicit examples (e.g., Eiffel Tower excluded from certain subsections, transmitting masts included). Notes indicate inclusions/exclusions (e.g., not including Eiffel Tower in 7.5.2; barbershop poles included). Auxiliary and associated auxiliary sections list more specific subtypes (rural houses, flat-roofed houses, chalets, urban houses, dwellings or buildings in ruins).

rubrics_metrics.name: 7.3 PARTS OF DWELLINGS OR OF BUILDINGS, INTERIORS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers doors, entrances, windows (including stained-glass), bays/balconies/balustrades/moucharabies, interiors, roofs, chimneys (with note excluding factory chimneys and hearths), shop window displays, staircases, blinds/shutters/awnings and other parts of dwellings or buildings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections (associated with principal 7.3.4) enumerate interiors like kitchens, bathrooms/sauna-rooms, bedrooms, cellars, etc. Notes clarify exclusions (not including factory chimneys (7.1.14) and hearths (13.3.1)).

rubrics_metrics.name: 7.5 MONUMENTS, STADIUMS, FOUNTAINS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers pyramids, recognized monuments (e.g., Great Wall, Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty), other ancient monuments, stadiums/amphitheaters/playgrounds, triumphal arches/porticos/town gates, labyrinths, totem poles, tombstones, fountains/basins/swimming pools/sprays/wells and other monuments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections (associated with 7.5.5) list ancient temples or parts thereof, columns, obelisks. Specific famous monuments may be referenced for classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7.11 STRUCTURAL WORKS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers bridges, tunnels, roads/intersections/road forks, railway lines, mooring posts/bollards, water hydrants/fire hydrants, dams and other structural works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections list common civil-engineering elements (bridges, tunnels, roads, railways, dams).

rubrics_metrics.name: 7.15 BUILDING MATERIALS, WALLS, GATES OR BARRIERS, SCAFFOLDING
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers stones for building/bricks, planks/plates/panels/flagstones, corrugated iron or other corrugated materials, representations of wood (including bark and cut wood grain), tiles, other building materials, walls/gates/barriers and scaffolding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes specify that representation of natural wood surfaces and wood cut against the grain are included; representation of wood as ornamental background is placed in category 25. Auxiliary sections list further subcategories and specific materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8. FOODSTUFFS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division heading covering food-related categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 8.1 (Bakers' products, pastry, confectionery, chocolate), 8.3 (Milk, dairy products, cheeses), 8.5 (Butchers' meat, pork products, fishmongers' products) and 8.7 (Other foodstuffs). See detailed principal-section entries for examples and auxiliary subdivisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.1 BAKERS’ PRODUCTS, PASTRY, CONFECTIONERY, CHOCOLATE
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers bread, rusks/slices of bread/spread sandwiches, bread rolls/brioches, croissants, small biscuits, pastries, ices, chocolate/confectionery, other bakers' products and includes wafer cones for ice cream and chewing gum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate pan loaves of specific shapes, types of small biscuits, tarts/flans/pies, cakes, slabs/sticks/squares of chocolate, pralines, lollipops, etc. Notes clarify inclusions (wafer cones) and specific auxiliary groupings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.3 MILK, DAIRY PRODUCTS, CHEESES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers milk, cream (except 8.3.2), whipped cream, butter/margarine (including pats/slabs/shell shapes), cheeses and other dairy products (except 8.7.15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections subdivide butter by presentation and cheeses by shape (round, square/rectangular, uncut, cut up).

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.5 BUTCHERS’ MEAT, PORK PRODUCTS, FISHMONGERS’ PRODUCTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers butchers' meat, pork products and fishmongers' products, including ham/legs of mutton/joints, sausages (fresh/dry)/salami, sliced products, poultry/game prepared for cooking, fish and other related products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list specific forms (ham, sausages, slices, cooked/prepared fish) and other butchers’ products.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8.7 OTHER FOODSTUFFS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers soups/beverages, macaroni/pasta, pizzas, filled dishes/plates, vegetable dishes/salads, crisps (chips) and similar products, popcorn, tacos/wraps/kebabs/empanadas, eggs (cooked), fruit salads/compotes, baked custard/puddings/omelettes, pancakes/crêpes/tortillas, sugar, animal foodstuffs and other foodstuffs not classified elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal and auxiliary numbering covers mixtures of foodstuffs classified in different divisions and miscellaneous foodstuffs. Specific subsections (8.7.16 etc.) and notes appear in the classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9. TEXTILES, CLOTHING, SEWING ACCESSORIES, HEADWEAR, FOOTWEAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering textile articles, clothing, sewing accessories, headwear and footwear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 9.1 (Textiles other than clothing, shuttles), 9.3 (Clothing), 9.5 (Sewing accessories, patterns), 9.7 (Headwear) and 9.9 (Footwear). Explanatory notes and auxiliary subdivisions specify many subtypes and exclusions (e.g., nets for fishing/hunting in other categories).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.1 TEXTILES OTHER THAN CLOTHING, SHUTTLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers thread, laces/braids/tapes/cords/ropes, stitches, embroidery/tea cloths/trimmings, ribbons/bows, cloth/network/flat linen/curtains/carpets (excluding nets for fishing/hunting/games), bed coverings/cushions/eiderdowns, cloth labels and other textile articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate presentations of thread (skeins, bobbins, balls, shuttles), stitches, cloth shapes (pieces, rolls, draped cloth, carpets), and samples of cloth. Notes reference related categories (e.g., 14.1.5, 9.1.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.3 CLOTHING
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers clothing generally (excluding headwear and footwear), and groups of clothes of different kinds; includes jackets/waistcoats/coats, trousers, suits/costumes, dresses/aprons/ladies' suits, ponchos, pullovers/sweaters, shirts/T-shirts/bodices, collars, ties, underwear/swimwear/diapers, stockings/socks, gloves, belts/buckles, bibs, clothing pockets, parts of clothing and diving suits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list many garment subtypes (jackets, suits, dresses, collars, ties) and parts of clothing. Notes indicate exclusions (headwear 9.7, footwear 9.9) and references to other categories for specific items (e.g., boxing gloves excluded).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.5 SEWING ACCESSORIES, PATTERNS FOR DRESSMAKING
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers needles/thimbles/hooks/pins (see also 14.3.1), other sewing accessories (excluding scissors and tape measures), buttons, press studs, slide fasteners, patterns for clothing, corset whalebones, stitchings/topstitchings and other sewing accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections specify types of needles (straight/curved, knitting needles), thimbles, crochet hooks, fastening hooks, pins, safety pins; buttons (various auxiliaries), slide fasteners and patterns. Notes clarify exclusions (scissors 14.7.18) and related categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.7 HEADWEAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers headwear and auxiliary subsections enumerate turbans, caps and berets, cocked hats, kepis, phrygian caps, fez, broad-brimmed hats (e.g., Mexican hats/cowboys' hats), cooks' caps, protective helmets (excluding armour helmets), mortarboards and other headwear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes specify exclusions (helmets as parts of armour 23.5.5) and specific named types; many auxiliary subsections list varied hat types and special cases (e.g., mortarboards).

rubrics_metrics.name: 9.9 FOOTWEAR
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers footwear and auxiliaries for clogs, low-heeled shoes, high-heeled shoes, boots/top boots, carpet slippers, sports footwear/ski boots, babies' footwear, sandals/flip flops, soles of boots and shoes, other parts of footwear and other footwear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes clarify exclusions (fastening hooks/buttons/slide fasteners/nails/eyelets classified elsewhere). Auxiliary subsections enumerate single item types and parts (soles, footprints).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10. TOBACCO, SMOKERS’ REQUISITES, MATCHES, TRAVEL GOODS, FANS, TOILET ARTICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering tobacco/smokers' requisites/matches, travel goods/fans/bags and toilet articles/mirrors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 10.1 (Tobacco, smokers' requisites, matches), 10.3 (Travel goods, fans, bags) and 10.5 (Toilet articles, mirrors). Each principal section has auxiliary listings with many specific items and notes about exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.1 TOBACCO, SMOKERS’ REQUISITES, MATCHES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers tobacco in various forms and smokers' requisites (pipes, hookahs, cigarette/cigar holders, pipe cleaners, cigar cutters, tobacco jars/pouches, lighters, ash trays, matches, other smokers' requisites).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list cut tobacco, cigars, cigarettes and other forms; note exclusions (not including tobacco leaves 5.3.1).

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.3 TRAVEL GOODS, FANS, BAGS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers sticks/umbrellas/parasols, fans, wallets/purses, bags/suitcases/trunks and other travel goods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include open umbrellas, shopping bags, satchels/briefcases, handbags, bag fasteners (note: not including slide fasteners 9.5.10), rucksacks, suitcases/trunks and other travel items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10.5 TOILET ARTICLES, MIRRORS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers toothbrushes/toothpaste doses, shaving articles (with exclusions), hair clippers, combs/hairbrushes, lipsticks, mirrors (excluding medical mirrors), sprays for toilet purposes, soap, other toilet/cosmetic products and associated accessories (hair dryers, razors, brushes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude sponges (11.7.1) and packaging containing cosmetic products classified elsewhere (19.3/19.7). Auxiliary sections enumerate open razors, safety razors, blades, electric razors, shaving brushes and hair dryers (associated with 13.3.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: 11. HOUSEHOLD UTENSILS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering household utensils (excluding those classified in categories 12, 13 or 19).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 11.1 (Knives, forks and spoons, kitchen utensils and machines), 11.3 (Containers for beverages, plates and dishes, kitchen utensils for serving/preparing/cooking food or drink) and 11.7 (Other household utensils). Each principal section contains many auxiliaries and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.1 KNIVES, FORKS AND SPOONS, KITCHEN UTENSILS AND MACHINES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers spoons, knives, forks, sets, chopsticks, spatulas, funnels, strainers/colanders, tin openers/bottle openers/corkscrews, vegetable grinders/meat mincers, chopping/carving boards, coffee filters/mills, pepper mills, mixers, rolling pins and other kitchen utensils or machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude kitchen utensils/machines classified in 11.3 and 13.3 and mortars (19.11.1). Auxiliary sections enumerate individual item types and presentations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.3 CONTAINERS FOR BEVERAGES, PLATES AND DISHES, KITCHEN UTENSILS FOR SERVING, PREPARING OR COOKING FOOD OR DRINK
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers drinking vessels/cups (trophies), eating/serving vessels/trays, bowls, teapots/coffee pots/kettles, saucepans/pots/stewpans/frying pans/cauldrons, serving jugs, plates and trays, cups with saucers, glasses, tankards and other related items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate glasses with or without stems, tankards, cups, trays, drinking straws, bowls, plates, sauce boats, cruets, salt/pepper containers, containers or plates containing food/drink, and other plates/dishes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11.7 OTHER HOUSEHOLD UTENSILS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers household utensils not classified in divisions 11.1 or 11.3, including coat hangers, clothes-pegs/pins, brushes/sponges/steel wool (excluding brushes for toilet purposes), brooms and window-cleaning instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list additional miscellaneous household implements; notes clarify exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12. FURNITURE, SANITARY INSTALLATIONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering furniture (including office furniture) and sanitary installations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections are 12.1 (Furniture) and 12.3 (Sanitary installations). Explanatory notes and auxiliaries enumerate beds/cots/cradles/hammocks/chairs/sofas/tables/desks/chests/wardrobes and sanitary fixtures (baths, showers, washbasins, water closets, taps).

rubrics_metrics.name: 12.1 FURNITURE
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers cots, beds, cradles, hammocks, chairs/armchairs/stools, benches/seats/sofas, tables/work benches/shop counters, desks, chests of drawers/trunks, cupboards/sideboards/safes/strongboxes, sets of shelves and other pieces of furniture; cushions are classified in 9.1.23; mirrors excluded (10.5.17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections detail mattresses, wedges, bolsters and other furniture subtypes. Note inclusion of office furniture.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12.3 SANITARY INSTALLATIONS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers sanitary installations including baths, showers, washbasins/sinks, water closets/bidets/flushing cisterns, taps (including taps not part of sanitary installations) and other sanitary installations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate baths, showers, water closets/bidets, taps and other sanitary equipment; taps may be included even when not part of a sanitary installation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13. LIGHTING, WIRELESS VALVES, HEATING, COOKING OR REFRIGERATING EQUIPMENT, WASHING MACHINES, DRYING EQUIPMENT
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering lighting and wireless valves, plus heating/cooking/refrigerating equipment and household machines like washing/drying equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 13.1 (Lighting, wireless valves) and 13.3 (Heating, cooking or refrigerating equipment, washing machines, drying equipment). Auxiliary lists give lamp types, oil lamps, fairy lights, street/table/hanging lamps, electric torches/headlights, light bulbs/tubes, wireless valves, washing machines, dishwashers, irons and other household equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13.1 LIGHTING, WIRELESS VALVES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers candles/candlesticks, flambeaux/torches (with noted exceptions), lamps/fairy lights/lanterns/wireless valves, oil lamps, hurricane lamps, street lamps, table lamps/Argand lamps/lampshades, hanging lamps, bracket lamps, electric torches/pocket lamps, signalling flashlights, vehicle headlights, electric light bulbs/tubes, wireless valves, parts of lamps and other lighting apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate specific lamp types and parts; notes exclude some items (e.g., certain exceptions) and include references to other categories where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13.3 HEATING, COOKING OR REFRIGERATING EQUIPMENT, WASHING MACHINES, DRYING EQUIPMENT
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers hearths, braziers, heating apparatus with open fire, boilers for heating, room stoves, radiators, sauna heating equipment, parts of heating apparatus, kitchen stoves/plate warmers/dish heaters/grills/barbecues and other cooking equipment, washing machines/dishwashers (machines), household drying equipment and irons/ironing apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include refrigerating equipment, hair dryers (associated with 13.3.24) and other household mechanical appliances. Notes clarify exclusions (e.g., kitchen machines 11.1.10, washing machines 13.3.23).

rubrics_metrics.name: 14. IRONMONGERY, TOOLS, LADDERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering heavy ironmongery (tubes/cables), small ironmongery articles/springs, keys/locks/padlocks, tools and agricultural implements and ladders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 14.1 (Tubes, cables, heavy ironmongery articles), 14.3 (Small ironmongery articles, springs), 14.5 (Keys for locks, locks, padlocks), 14.7 (Tools), 14.9 (Agricultural or horticultural implements, ice axes), and 14.11 (Ladders). Many auxiliaries enumerate specific fastenings, screws, nuts, hooks, door handles, hinges, tongs, spanners, saws and related items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.1 TUBES, CABLES, HEAVY IRONMONGERY ARTICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers tubes/pipes/sluices, bars/cables (including electric cables), chains/links of chain, girders/spars/rods/rails, profiles, iron rods for reinforcing concrete and other heavy ironmongery articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list bent/coiled/twisted tubes, joints of pipes, cables braided/twisted, cable sections, block chains, links of chain, ring chains, girders and profiles. Notes reference inclusion of electric cables and relations to other divisions (9.1.7).

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.3 SMALL IRONMONGERY ARTICLES, SPRINGS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers nails/screws/bolts/rivets/dowel pins/screw nuts/drawing pins and all springs of whatever kind/purpose; notes exclude door closers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate nails, screws, crossed fastenings, screw nuts, hooks, terminal connectors for cables, cable clamps, collars, rings, washers, eyelets, clips, joints, gaskets, door handles/hinges, door bolts/latches and other small ironmongery articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.5 KEYS FOR LOCKS, LOCKS, PADLOCKS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers keys (one, two or more), parts of keys, keyrings, locks, escutcheons, padlocks and handcuffs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections describe keys by number and by bow shape (circular, oval, lobed, diamond-shaped, flat keys, other shapes) and other specific key-related subtypes.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.7 TOOLS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers hammers/sledge-hammers/mallets, axes, anvils/shoemakers' lasts, tongs/pincers, tweezers, wedge keys/spanners/screwdrivers, braces/hand drills, power drills/pneumatic hammers, bits/drills, sharpening stones, saws/saw benches/chain saws, saw blades or belts of band saws, chains of chain saws, cutlery, knives/shoemakers' cutters, scissors, sheep shears, bricklayers' trowels/plasterers' hawks and other tools (including handles). Notes exclude agricultural implements (14.9) and open razors/table knives/daggers which are classified elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate combinations (two crossed hammers), specific tool types (tongs, tweezers), and note inclusions of multifunction knives and handles.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.9 AGRICULTURAL OR HORTICULTURAL IMPLEMENTS, ICE AXES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers spades, pickaxes/ice axes/hoes, scythes/sickles and other agricultural/horticultural implements such as rakes and ploughs/ploughshares.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections distinguish spade shapes (round/pointed vs rectangular/square) and list rakes and plough components under auxiliaries to 14.9.10.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14.11 LADDERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers ladders with auxiliary subsections for single ladders, double ladders, stepladders and swimming pool ladders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple classification by ladder type; auxiliaries enumerate variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15. MACHINERY, MOTORS, ENGINES
rubrics_metrics.description: Division for machines and mechanical appliances for industry, agriculture, household, office, wheels/bearings and electrical equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 15.1 (Machines for industry or agriculture, industrial installations, motors, engines, various mechanical appliances), 15.3 (Machines for household use, spinning wheels), 15.5 (Office machines), 15.7 (Wheels, bearings) and 15.9 (Electrical equipment). Notes exclude certain household/office categories from industrial sections and cross-reference related categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.1 MACHINES FOR INDUSTRY OR AGRICULTURE, INDUSTRIAL INSTALLATIONS, MOTORS, ENGINES, VARIOUS MECHANICAL APPLIANCES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers machines for industry and industrial installations (pressing, grinding, mixing, distilling, excavating, millstones), conveyor belts, motors/engines, propellers/ventilators/blowers/turbines/burners (including propellers for aircraft or ships), parts of machines (including robotic arms), cranes/blocks/pulleys, sprayers/paint sprayguns/fire extinguishers/water sprinklers, machines for agriculture (including lawn mowers), petrol pumps, automatic distributors/coin-fed vending machines/cash registers and various other mechanical appliances including door closers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes exclude household kitchen machines (11.1.10), household washing machines (13.3.23), power drills/pneumatic hammers (14.7.6) and classify agricultural tools in 14.9. Auxiliary sections list parts and examples such as robotic arms.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.3 MACHINES FOR HOUSEHOLD USE, SPINNING WHEELS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers machines for household use (excluding kitchen machines 11.1.10, washing machines 13.3.23, household drying equipment 13.3.24) and spinning wheels/distaffs/looms; auxiliaries include sewing machines, vacuum cleaners/polishers and other household machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate common household machines such as sewing machines and vacuum cleaners; spinning wheels listed under 15.3.11.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.5 OFFICE MACHINES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers office machines such as typewriters (not including word processors 16.1.4) and other office machines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include other specific office devices; notes exclude overlaps with computer/word processor categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.7 WHEELS, BEARINGS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers cog wheels/wheel cogs, ships' wheels/capstans/paddle wheels, other wheels (with or without spokes), ball bearings and other bearings, gearing/transmission wheels, wheels or wheel segments with wings and other wheel/bearing motifs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate sawtoothed wheels, segments of cog wheels, cog wheels with spokes and classification auxiliaries (wheels without inscription, with inscription, with human beings/animals/plants, or with other figurative elements). Notes exclude vehicle wheels mounted on axles (18.1.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 15.9 ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers electrical equipment (excluding electric lamps/wireless valves 13.1.6 and electric cables 14.1.5), with auxiliaries for batteries/piles, sparking plugs, electrical accessories for vehicles, electric plugs, switches, outlets, transistors/diodes/resistors/magnets, integrated circuits and other electrical apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list batteries/piles, vehicle electrical accessories and various electrical components (integrated circuits, insulators). Notes clarify exclusions of overlapping lighting/cable categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16. TELECOMMUNICATIONS, SOUND RECORDING OR REPRODUCTION, COMPUTERS, PHOTOGRAPHY, CINEMATOGRAPHY, OPTICS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering telecommunications, sound recording/reproduction, computers and photographic/cinematographic/optical apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 16.1 (Telecommunications, sound recording or reproduction, computers) and 16.3 (Photography, cinematography, optics). Auxiliaries list aerials/satellite dishes/pylons, telecommunication apparatus, computers/word processors/mice/keyboards, radio/TV apparatus, record players, discs/CDs/DVDs, recording media, photographic apparatus/projection apparatus/lanterns, spectacles/binoculars/telescopes/microscopes and other optical instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16.1 TELECOMMUNICATIONS, SOUND RECORDING OR REPRODUCTION, COMPUTERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers aerials/satellite dishes/pylons/posts/telephone/electricity lines, telecommunication/television/sound recording/reproduction apparatus and equipment, computers, word processors, computer mice/keyboards, telephone receivers, fax machines, microphones, headphones, record players, discs/CDs/DVDs, recording tapes/cassettes and other apparatus for telecommunication or recording/reproduction of sound.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections associated with 16.1.4 cover radio/television apparatus (including image reproduction/video). Notes include that wireless valves are classified elsewhere (13.1.6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 16.3 PHOTOGRAPHY, CINEMATOGRAPHY, OPTICS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers photographic/cinematographic apparatus, projection apparatus and lanterns (including video cameras/traffic radars/photographic lenses), other apparatus/instruments/equipment for photography/cinema, spectacles/spectacle frames, binoculars/telescopes/microscopes, magnifying glasses with handle, optical lenses/contact lenses/spectacle lenses and other optical apparatus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections include iris diaphragms, films and containers for films. Notes reference inclusion of lenses and video equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17. HOROLOGICAL INSTRUMENTS, JEWELRY, WEIGHTS AND MEASURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering time-measuring instruments, jewelry, balances/weights and measures (including calculating instruments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 17.1 (Horological and other time-measuring instruments), 17.2 (Jewelry), 17.3 (Balances, weights) and 17.5 (Measures). Auxiliaries specify watches/clocks/chronometers/sundials/sandglasses, precious stones/pearls/jewelry items, balances and various measuring instruments (rulers, slide rules, gauges, compasses, thermometers, levels).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.1 HOROLOGICAL AND OTHER TIME-MEASURING INSTRUMENTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers horological instruments including circular dials (with or without hands), non-circular dials, hands of instruments, other parts, watches, chronometers, clocks/alarm clocks, sundials, sandglasses and other time-measuring instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections distinguish dial shapes, hands and parts of horological instruments; notes exclude dials of measuring instruments other than horological (17.5.1) and spiral springs (14.3.21).

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.2 JEWELRY
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers precious stones (including cut facets), pearls, necklaces/bracelets/chains, rings and wedding rings, cuff links, tie pins, hat pins and other jewels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections list precious stones cut in facets and other representations of precious stones; pearls or precious stones in an oyster are specifically noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.3 BALANCES, WEIGHTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers balances and weights, including balances with two trays, other balances, parts of balances and weights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Auxiliary sections enumerate specific balance types and parts; weights are listed under auxiliaries as well.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17.5 MEASURES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers measures including instruments for linear measurement (yardsticks, graduated rulers, tape measures, surveyors' tapes and chains), slide rules, calculating disks/cylinders, abacuses, gauges, calipers, vernier gauges, micrometers, compasses for draftsmen/masons, squares and French curves, plumb lines, levels, thermometers and other measuring instruments/markers (including weather vanes/anemometers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes clarify exclusions (not including time-measuring instruments 17.1 or balances 17.3). Auxiliary sections enumerate many specific measuring instruments and related markers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18. TRANSPORT, EQUIPMENT FOR ANIMALS
rubrics_metrics.description: Division covering land vehicles, equipment for animals, vehicles for use on water and amphibious vehicles, anchors/buoys/lifebelts, aerial or space vehicles, traffic signs and indicator boards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Principal sections include 18.1 (Land vehicles), 18.2 (Equipment for animals), 18.3 (Vehicles for use on water and amphibious vehicles), 18.4 (Anchors; buoys or lifebelts), 18.5 (Aerial or space vehicles), and 18.7 (Traffic signs and indicator boards). Each principal section contains many auxiliaries and examples for specific vehicle and transport motifs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18.1 LAND VEHICLES
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers vehicles propelled by human or animal power, bicycles, motorcycles, motor scooters, tricycles, motor road vehicles, rail vehicles/trains/tramcars, other land vehicles, tyres/tyre prints/snow chains/axles/wheels/steering wheels/radiators/exhausts/shock absorbers and other parts of land vehicles; also stylized land vehicles and other means of transport not classified in divisions 18.3 and 18.5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes include exclusions and references to related subcategories (e.g., vehicle parts classification 18.1.21); auxiliaries enumerate specific vehicle types and parts.
